İbadet Takip, uygulamayı kullanırken nam: İbadet Takip accesses your location while you use the app to calculate prayer times, determine the Qibla direction, and show weather and nearby mosques. Your location is sent to the İbadet Takip server to obtain this information. This consent does not enable background mosque tracking. Choosing Not now disables location-dependent features; other features remain available.
İbadet Takip, yakındaki camileri takip e: İbadet Takip accesses your location even when the app is closed or not in use to track nearby mosques and send mosque proximity notifications during prayer times. Your location is sent to the İbadet Takip server to find nearby mosques. Accepting continues to the Android location permission step. In app settings, choose Permissions → Location → Allow all the time, then return to the app. Choosing Not now keeps background mosque tracking off and does not affect location permission for prayer times and Qibla while using the app.
